title: Pizza Sales Performance Analysis
headline: What makes a better sales day?
summary: A sales performance study connecting order data with questions about products, timing and customer demand.
coverNote: The cover is an editorial illustration. SQL queries and the original Power BI report are available in the repository.

blocks.html:
The question

Which products and sales periods matter most, and how can the findings guide promotions and business planning?

The approach

Use SQL to explore revenue, order volume, category, size and timing. Bring the findings into Power BI views so the relationships can be read together.

What it shows

Classic pizzas led revenue, large sizes performed strongly, and Friday was the busiest sales day. The study translates those patterns into focused promotion and cross-selling ideas.
